title: The Grand Inquisitor
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: The Grand Inquisitor was at one time a Jedi Temple guard, hand selected by Emperor Palpatine to lead his newly created group of Jedi-hunting Inquisitors. The Grand Inquisitor was instrumental in the hunt for Obi-Wan Kenobi and exposing the Third Sister's duplicity. He was later tasked by his Master to hunt down and deal with Kanan Jarrus and his apprentice Ezra Bridger.
